_comment: The Pickleball page. Programs stay high-level on purpose — the booking system is the source of truth for days, times and prices, so nothing here can go stale against it. Coaches and FAQs are the parts that actually churn. Each program links to its own filtered listing on the booking system; "Book a Court" everywhere else goes to /book.

programs.name: Open Play
programs.body: Sessions run all week across our nine indoor courts. Turn up on your own or with a partner and we will get you into a game at your level. No membership needed.

programs.name: Leagues
programs.lead: A season, a team, a standings table.
programs.body: Organised play across skill divisions, running in seasons through the year. Sign up as a full team or as an individual and we will place you. Divisions and start dates are listed on the booking system.

programs.name: Lessons & Clinics
programs.lead: One-on-one, small group, or a full clinic.
programs.body: We do 1-on-1s, Play With a Pro, group and small-group lessons, and clinics. We can tailor a lesson to suit any level of player with any number of guests.

programs.name: Tournaments
programs.body: Sanctioned and in-house events through the year. Some run on our own booking system and some on PickleballTournaments.com — each link below goes straight to that event.

programs.name: Family Programming
programs.body: Nights and weekends built for families — glow-in-the-dark socials, free court time for kids, and more on the way.

faqLead: In case you have any additional questions, call our front desk.

faqs.q: I've never played pickleball before — is ELEVENO for me?
faqs.a: 100% yes. We have many options for beginners and those new to the game. Our intro classes cater to any age, and we've seen great players anywhere from 5 to 95. One of the things we love most about ELEVENO — and pickleball in general — is its inclusivity: grandparents playing with grandkids, men playing with women. If you can hold the paddle, we can get you out there.

faqs.q: What are the different types of paddles?
faqs.a:
Elongated — longer paddle length, generally geared toward power.
Hybrid — between Standard and Elongated, can be power or control.
Standard (Widebody) — wider head, generally geared toward control.

faqs.q: What sort of lessons do you do here?
faqs.a: We do 1-on-1s, Play With a Pro, group and small-group lessons, and clinics. We can tailor a lesson to suit any level of player with any number of guests.

etiquette.name: Footwear
etiquette.body: On court, we always recommend court shoes. More than a paddle or a fancy new shirt, the correct shoe is the most important. It lessens the chance of injury and allows players to move with more confidence.

etiquette.name: Only water allowed on court
etiquette.body: Any beverage other than water will stain the courts. If there is a spill, find a towel and clean it up as soon as you can.

etiquette.name: What to do when a ball enters another court
etiquette.body: Yell "Ball on court!" and stop play immediately. Better to stop a good rally than have someone step on a ball and twist an ankle.
